description: Use this before an agent inbox sends mail. Read-only; requires auth and inbox_read. Input: inbox_id (optional; inbox id, username, or email). Omit inbox_id when the key is limited to one inbox and Cooper grades that inbox. An account-wide key must pass inbox_id. Another inbox is HTTP 404 inbox_not_found. A missing key is HTTP 401. Returns {inbox_id, address, checked_at, summary:{pass, warn, fail, info, total}, checks:[{id, title, status, detail, fix?}]}. status is pass, warn, fail, or info. info means Cooper does not store that control. The ten checks are key scope, inbound screening, allowed senders, send limits, webhook signing, human approval, send caps and idempotency, domain reputation, tenant isolation, and the event log. The result lists key id and prefix and webhook ids. It does not return key material or a webhook signing value.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox. Another inbox is 404 inbox_not_found.

name: cooper_security_check

outputSchema.description: Launch checks for one inbox. No key material and no webhook signing value.

checks.description: The ten checks, in a fixed order. status is pass, warn, fail, or info.

detail.description: What Cooper stored for this inbox. No key material and no webhook signing value.

fix.description: Present when status is not pass. action is what to change. docs_url is the guide.

action.description: What to change on this inbox.

docs_url.description: https URL of the Cooper docs for that change.

id.description: Stable check id, such as key_scope or webhook_signing.

summary.description: How many checks are pass, warn, fail, and info. total is 10.

fail.description: How many checks found a missing control.

info.description: How many checks Cooper cannot grade because it does not store that control.

warn.description: How many checks need a tighter setting.

title: Inbox security check
